verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a legal-document notarization and incorporation service, so asking about pre-signature contract approval workflows is a fair question for it. The evidence only covers API-driven notarization workflows, signer management and webhook notifications. Nothing documents configurable internal approval routing for contracts before signature, so this is adjacent support and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can route contracts through configurable approval workflows before signature
